title: Autumn Leaves Reveal Colours That Were Already There
post_title: Autumn Leaves Reveal Colours That Were Already There | QuantaTale
post_description: Some autumn colours were hidden inside green leaves all along. Discover the science behind it. Sources: https://www.nesdis.noaa.gov/about/k-12-education/understanding-our-planet/why-do-leaves-change-color https://www.fs.usda.gov/nrs/pubs/jrnl/2009/nrs_2009_archetti_001.pdf #Science #ScienceFacts #Education #QuantaTale
narration: A green leaf contains several pigments, not just green chlorophyll. During the growing season, chlorophyll is abundant and masks many yellow and orange pigments called carotenoids. As days shorten and trees prepare for winter, chlorophyll breaks down, allowing those colours to become visible. Red pigments called anthocyanins can also be produced in autumn. The exact display depends on the tree species and weather. The colour change is a seasonal process, not paint appearing on leaves.
